name: DeFi Plaza single-sided removeLiquidity rounds reserve to zero
summary: DeFiPlaza.removeLiquidity pays X*(1-F) of one token with F=(1-R)^16 computed in truncating 0.64 fixed point and no bound on the burnt LP fraction R. For R above roughly 0.94, F truncates to 0 and the entire reserve is paid out, breaking the product invariant it is meant to preserve; swap() then prices against a zero input reserve and pays the whole output reserve for 1 wei, so a flash-loaned LP majority emptied all 16 reserves.

loss.notes: Exact net depletion of the pool's 16 reserves in the single exploit transaction: every reserve fell from its block-20240538 balance to 1 base unit (USDT to 0). Attacker swap and addMultiple inputs were returned within the same transaction and are netted out, so the components are LP-owned assets only. Valued at the last DefiLlama points before the exploit (source-7, 227-289 s earlier); DFP2 has sparse points, so it uses the pre-exploit quote at 1720180509 (source-9) rather than the 1720185404 point taken after the drain, when DFP2 later fell to 0.006. The profit went to an MEV frontrunner copying the original attacker's pending transaction; later recoveries, if any, are not deducted.

ageReset.description: Immutable direct DeFiPlaza runtime contains the removeLiquidity truncation and the zero-reserve swap pricing; later timelock listing swaps and fee change do not touch that arithmetic.

sources.note: Reviewed anchor, root cause and earliest use. debug_traceTransaction(callTracer) of source-1 (block 20240539, index 0, status 1, sender 0xfde0d1575ed8e06fbf36256bcdfa1f359281455a -> MEV contract 0x6980a47bee930a4584b09ee79ebe46484fbdbdd0, Balancer and Aave flash loans) shows calls into the pool: 8 swap (0xfe029156; last two pay 86.377548523416239752 and 1727.550970468324795040 ETH), addMultiple (0xce359797, 32732.5447036103645376 ETH) minting 232672546280000190645164 LP, removeLiquidity(0xc4ccdeea, LPamount 232672546280000190645164, outputToken 0x0, min 0) returning 34551019409366495900800 wei, then 15 chained 1-unit swaps (ETH->SPELL->YFI->WBTC->DFP2->CVX->LINK->eXRD->DAI->SUSHI->MATIC->MKR->USDC->COMP->CRV->USDT). totalSupply at block 20240538 is 12965148015156591511590, so R=LP/(TS0+LP)=0.9472; reproducing source-5 arithmetic, F=(1<<64)-(LP<<64)/TS = 973648478502562634, (1-R)^4 = 143169197494647, (1-R)^16 = 0, so actualOutput equals the whole ETH balance (exact math leaves about 125 wei). With the ETH reserve at 0, swap() computes out = net*B/((0<<64)+net) = B, paying each full output reserve for 1 wei; each drained reserve then feeds the next hop. Earliest-use scan: eth_getLogs on the pool, blocks 13346613..26077651 in 1,000,000-block chunks, 90,282 logs; replaying LP Transfer mint/burn logs gives the pre-burn supply for each of 1730 LiquidityRemoved(address,address,uint256,uint256) events (topic 0x3b5c196aff80bb96c03b41c96906b66827014de931d1b36e0ede6ee8caeb4bf9): source-1 is the only one with truncated F=0; the next-largest R is 0.01518 (0x2410c5cb2bb8e33a80e0ba57fbf60485db77fcd5c2983e181af065c1c96c2ed8, block 13348780). Original attacker 0x14b362d2e38250604f21a334d71c13e2ed478467 deployed attack contract 0xa4e8969bba1e1d48c30c948de0884cdff43e2d54 at block 20240539 index 3 and its attack 0xe00b0998d71b0e657379be196babd1637a653c100e8162853ca6616c3970790d (block 20240540) reverted; its 14 earlier transactions (blocks 19588496..19840698) never call the pool directly, and the pool-wide LiquidityRemoved replay above bounds any indirect use. Post-exploit pool activity (blocks 20240540..26077651: 936 Swapped, 12 LiquidityAdded) moves dust only.

Verified DeFiPlaza standard-JSON source at https://etherscan.io/address/0xe68c1d72340aeefe5be76eda63ae2f4bc7514110#code; reproduce Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=1. Compiler v0.8.6+commit.11564f7e, not a proxy. SHA-256 of the returned SourceCode string (UTF-8, no trailing newline): 871bbd3bd2f54bacf46c210ab7da9ec95ec32c9f0adad93e346599506310d4c5. Inspect contracts/DeFiPlaza.sol removeLiquidity (F_ squared and shifted >>192 twice, actualOutput = initialBalance*((1<<64)-F_)>>64, no cap on LPamount relative to totalSupply unlike addLiquidity's 'Too much at once' check) and swap (outputAmount = netInputAmount*initialOutputBalance/((initialInputBalance<<64)+netInputAmount)).

Reviewed gross loss. eth_getTransactionReceipt(source-1): 265 logs; summing Transfer(address,address,uint256) logs into minus out of the pool per token gives net pool depletion equal to balanceOf(pool) at block 20240538 minus balanceOf at block 20240539 for all 15 ERC-20s (every token ends at 1 base unit, USDT at 0), e.g. USDT 13504300602, WBTC 24367467, SPELL 24541399146686254066632301. Native ETH: callTracer value flows net -4546186764390328407 wei, matching eth_getBalance(pool) 4546186764390328408 at 20240538 and 1 at 20240539. decimals() read onchain (USDT/USDC 6, WBTC 8, others 18). Unit prices from source-7 (DefiLlama batch queried at 1720185035; returned points 1720185046..1720185108, all before the exploit; native ETH at WETH) and source-9 for DFP2. Components sum to 216350.63 USD; each reserve was worth 13.2k-13.8k USD, consistent with a balanced 16-token pool.

Reviewed artifact identity and age history. eth_getCode(pool) is empty at block 13346612; keccak256 of runtime is 0x326fdd232797589c98f3c79b927d9b6375680e16f970c0536494cb2f45454787 at deployment block 13346613 and at 20240538. Source-4 receipt: status 1, top-level creation at index 293 by 0x0422afb5481a21b3fea2c94e08dfad45da1975b7, contractAddress = pool. The verified runtime (source-5) has no delegatecall, upgrade or selfdestruct path. Configuration review: Etherscan txlist of the pool, blocks 0..20240539 (11427 unique txs), has only these admin calls: transferOwnership at 13348402 and 13492092 (to Timelock 0x266ca88c616ff9d55dfffa7d133cf2b097e79845), unlockExchange at 13351365, setAdmin at 13491638. Timelock txlist to 20240539 shows 9 execute calls; those targeting the pool are changeListing(AAVE->SPELL) 0x19bfb286be58503b26e51fb31220730c108f2a0a4bf781818aec8d3f84217bd2 and changeListing(UNI->CVX) 0xf9108416336b253ecbcdecf4642853828e00579ae475b2b82e0cb197bed44aaf (BootstrapCompleted at 13628581 and 14037856) and setTradingFee(0xff3b645a1cac0800) 0x6f2854c8c9260551765d21c3be1978c5386e753051bed35bb7d28dbde2e82ab7; the rest target 0x3a2b8cc91af8bf45f3ec61e779ee1c2ba6b7e694. removeLiquidity applies no fee and its truncation holds for any listed token set, and a zero input reserve makes swap() pay the full output reserve whatever the fee, so none of these values is necessary to the condition; deployment supplies the age (86916029 s).
